about.heading: About Our Company
about.paragraph: Lianyungang Huayin Mining Investment International Trade Co., Ltd. is rooted in Lianyungang, the eastern bridgehead of the New Eurasian Land Bridge. Relying on the advantages of port hubs and free trade zone policies, the company focuses on bilateral trade between China and India. It is a comprehensive international trade enterprise integrating mineral investment, bulk commodity trade, engineering electromechanical export, and cross-border supply chain services.

trade.pageSubtitle: Bridging India and China with reliable trade across minerals, agriculture, machinery and industrial goods.

services.heading: Business Services
services.intro: From mineral sourcing and investment to logistics, customs clearance, and cross-border support, our full-service platform serves China and India with precision and confidence.
